restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text: I am not quite agreed with others comments. All staffs seems professional but they actually not able to provide you service in one visit. You need to go multiple times to see different doctors for different services. At the end, you wasted much time just to do treatments which can normally been done by one dentist. A ridiculous experience for me.

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text: Experienced dentists and staffs. Cozy atmosphere for kids. Highly recommend for everyone!!

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text:
They charged me 2500B even though nothing was fixed.
The first time, they did something to keep the crown in place,
but it fell out in two days. The second time, they quoted me 70,000B just for the estimate, but charged me 1000B without doing any treatment.

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text: This was a truly awful teeth cleaning experience. Because the receptionist was Japanese and it was a dental clinic with a Japanese name, I felt more confident and booked the appointment. The Japanese staff told me the service would cost 1200-1500 Thai Baht. When I arrived at the clinic, a Thai female dentist examined my teeth and then told me they were very dirty (of course, dirty teeth need cleaning), requiring special tools and charging 2000 Thai Baht. I agreed while already in the cleaning chair. After the cleaning, I didn't feel like they used any special tools; it was the same process as my teeth cleaning in Hong Kong. That evening, when I brushed my teeth, I found some stains that hadn't been removed. I was absolutely furious! I had to write this down because I was ripped off and didn't even get my teeth cleaned properly.

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text: The doctor is never there, and they charge you for two consultations. They have no skills and it's expensive, so you should avoid it!

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text: There was a kind Japanese staff member who provided excellent treatment.

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text:
I came here for a cavity treatment.
I had another appointment after the treatment, so I was short on time and asked for a rush appointment, but I'm grateful for the excellent service.

I was also impressed by the way you pointed out the locations of teeth that are at risk of cavities and explained how to prevent them.

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text: I was charged 3,000 baht just for tartar removal. When I was billed, it was changed to periodontal disease treatment, which increased the fee. I never mentioned periodontal disease during or after the treatment... …

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text: The doctors and staff at Fukumori were all very kind, so I was able to receive treatment with peace of mind. They also handled my insurance claim free of charge, which was very helpful!

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text: The treatment was fully in Japanese, so I was able to receive it with peace of mind.

restaurant_name: บริษัท ฟูกุโมริ ทันตกรรม คลินิก จำกัด（Fukumori Dental Clinic）
text:
They provided all the support for insurance applications free of charge, which was extremely helpful! 
I'm grateful for the kind support provided by the Japanese staff. 

I'd like to continue using their services in the future.
